changelog: 5.9.29 (Build 5929): NEW Google Drive update channel - Settings > Ruby Updater now has a 'Get the latest update (Google Drive)' button, and the update popup has a 'Get it from Google Drive' button too. Both open the newest RubyOS file from Google Drive under one link that never changes: download it and open it to update. Works even where GitHub is blocked, like on school Chromebooks.
Everything else is unchanged: the Yes/No update popup, fast update checking (about 3 seconds), the red roadblock screen with automatic fallback, and Ruby AI stays off until its API key is ready.
